note: Places of the map that Tools / Snow / Blender Context can export for the Blender agent. Either a rect in a frame (centre x,z in Unity world, yaw in degrees, rect [u0, v0, u1, v1] in metres: u along the frame's x, v along its z) or 'around' an object path (its position and yaw, rect = +-size/2). margin: extra metres on every side. The scene must be the open one.
